title: The Uprising in the ‘Periphery’: Bengal 1857–58
note: Niladri Chatterjee's doctoral thesis examines the 1857–58 uprising in Bengal, including the Chittagong outbreak and the movement of mutineers from the region.
attribution: Niladri Chatterjee, SOAS University of London
whyItMatters: An academic study of the Bengal uprising provides regional context for the Chittagong events and helps distinguish the wider campaign from later local memory.
